ok so here's how we get to building a 100M company in two weeks before thanksgiving.. 

first, our preseed plan. we're going to raise $2M. why $2M? simple. $200k for the launch video, $200k to promote the launch video to xM impressions - i have six agencies lined up for this don't sweat with no paid partnerships tag duhh, and $500k for the tokens i'm going to obliterate to have a resemblance of a product. again its all token spend and no employee spend because vcs dont want that. solo founders is hot again so i can fully get away with this lfg.

ok, so next we use the token spend that i can vibe code and sell to "wink friendly wink" customers and have them give me LOIs and cARR - in return for using their products obviously. scratch mine, scratch yours. ok then i can fully wrap in the most creative financial metrics possible to show xM in revenue of ARR because who even knows what that means anymore. 

and then i'm going to run the tighteeest possible process as possible for my "already oversubscribed seed". get some sick angels at a discount duhh, fomo VCs, get that tier 1 TS, shop it, and tranche it to the moon baby. first at 40M, then 80M and then finally a few angels at $100M. 

of course i'm going to incorporate the company as late as possible even though all the machinery is there. so i can claim 0->10M in revenue on day 14 or whatever. 

and yeah completely forgot that i need a sick vision and a full deck, that will need $100k for someone to drill that to me cause i ain't got no clue what this category even means. don't sweat, there's a fundraising expert who might take x% and some cash or whatever to help me whisper to the right networks. yeah, that's a thing. 

diligence? who needs charts and due diligence, we live in the token economy, and lfg economy baby. elections and the market selloff? don't sweat, the seed market is still red hot, it might take a day more, but this will still most def work.

anyway, i'm going to go try this and i'll see you in two weeks eh?

(before i get obliterated this is satire, but every sentence in there individually has personally happened to me)
tweets.summary_en: A satirical playbook for reaching a $100M startup valuation in two weeks skewers hype-driven AI fundraising: lavish launch marketing, token-heavy product development, reciprocal customer deals, and inflated revenue metrics. Investor FOMO, escalating funding valuations, and delayed incorporation manufacture the appearance of extraordinary growth.

podcasts.title: Controlling Biology - Fabian Theis, Helmholtz Munich

slang_glossary.definition_zh: 风险投资或风险投资人；原文中指投资初创公司的人。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A playful label for someone considered outstanding as both a writer and a venture capitalist.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对兼具出色写作能力与风险投资能力的人的俏皮称呼。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In this context, performed exceptionally well or created something impressive; elsewhere, it can mean ruined or exhausted.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 此处表示「发挥出色」或「做出了很厉害的东西」；在其他语境中也可能表示「完蛋了」或「累垮了」。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An instruction or input given to an AI model to guide its response.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 提示词：提供给 AI 模型、用于引导其输出的指令或输入。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An informal way to call someone's attention, especially by tagging them online.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 在线「呼叫」某人，常通过 @ 对方来引起注意。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Product manager in this context: someone responsible for a product's direction and priorities.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 此处指产品经理，负责产品方向与需求优先级。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Amazed me or radically expanded my understanding.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 让我大开眼界；让我极为震撼。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Releasing a product, feature, or piece of content so people can use or access it.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 发布或交付产品、功能或内容，让用户能够使用或获取。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Shorthand here for organizations that develop AI models.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 此处是 AI 模型研发机构或公司的简称。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Software whose source code is available under a license that permits use, modification, and redistribution.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 开源：源代码通过允许使用、修改和再分发的许可证提供的软件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To develop over time and eventually reach an outcome.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 逐步发展、演变，并最终产生某种结果。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An informal written abbreviation for people.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: people 的非正式书面缩写，意为「人们」。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A niche animal-welfare topic concerned with the living conditions and treatment of shrimp.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 虾类福利：关注虾的生活条件与所受对待的动物福利议题。

slang_glossary.definition_en: AI systems that can take actions, use tools, and carry out tasks toward a goal.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 智能体：能够采取行动、调用工具并朝某个目标执行任务的 AI 系统。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Applications designed for making or editing content such as videos, games, or graphics.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 创作者应用：用于制作或编辑视频、游戏、图像等内容的软件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Model Context Protocol: a standard for connecting AI applications to external tools and data sources.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 模型上下文协议：用于将 AI 应用连接到外部工具和数据源的标准。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Experienced users who use a tool extensively and often rely on its advanced features.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 资深用户或重度用户：频繁使用工具，并熟练运用高级功能的人。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An abbreviation for the video game Grand Theft Auto VI.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 电子游戏《侠盗猎车手 VI》的简称。

slang_glossary.definition_en: WebAssembly: a portable binary instruction format used to run compiled code in browsers and other environments.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: WebAssembly 的简称：一种可移植的二进制指令格式，可在浏览器等环境中运行编译后的代码。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A meme expressing surprise that something happened before a long-awaited game's release; the sample adapts it to an imagined WebAssembly version.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 一种网络梗，用「某事竟然比 GTA 6 还先出现」表达惊讶；原文将其改编为对 WebAssembly 版本的想象。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Graphics processing units: processors suited to parallel computation and widely used for AI training and inference.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 图形处理器：擅长并行计算，广泛用于 AI 模型训练与推理。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An AI capability for operating graphical interfaces through actions such as clicking, typing, and scrolling.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 计算机操作能力：AI 通过点击、输入和滚动等动作操作图形界面的能力。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Units of text or other represented information that an AI model processes.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 词元：AI 模型处理文本或其他信息时使用的基本单位。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A portion of financing, an investment, or securities separated from a larger total.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 融资、投资或证券总额中划分出来的一批、一部分或一个层级。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An investment opportunity attracting strong interest, or a particularly attractive commercial offer.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 热门投资项目；也可指特别有吸引力的交易或优惠。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A very early startup funding stage, typically before a seed round.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 种子前轮：通常发生在种子轮之前的初创企业早期融资阶段。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A promotional video introducing a new product, feature, or company.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 发布宣传视频：用于介绍新产品、新功能或新公司的推广视频。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Slang for something exceptionally good, exciting, or memorable, especially a song or piece of content.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 形容特别精彩、带劲或令人难忘的作品，尤其常用于歌曲或内容。
